headline: UVU 🏫 SECURITY LAPSES 🔍 Let CHARLIE KIRK 🗣️ Get SHOT ☠️
text:
INDEPENDENT 📋 review 📑 just DROPPED 💥 a BOMBSHELL 🧨 on those UTAH 🏔️ campus 🏫 security 🛡️ lapses 🔓 that got conservative 🗳️ activist 🗣️ CHARLIE 🐺 KIRK shot ☠️ dead 💀 last year 📅 at Utah 🏜️ Valley 🏞️ University 🏛️!! The report 📜 says 🗣️ UVU never did a proper ✍️ written 📝 security 🛡️ assessment 📊 or event 🎉 action 📋 plan 📝 instead deferring 🙇 key 🔑 decisions 🤔 to Kirk's 🐺 Turning 🔄 Point 📍 USA 🇺🇸 conservative 🗳️ crew 👥 who basically ran 🏃 the whole 🍑 show 🎭!! Kirk's 🐺 own aides 🧳 insisted 😤 on that outdoor 🌳 venue 🏞️ overriding 🚫 campus 🏫 officials 👮 concerns 😟 who then failed ❌ to properly 📏 assess ⚖️ the rooftop 🏠 dangers ☠️ bro 🧔 this was down 🥾 bad from jump 🦘!! "We raised 🖐️ red 🚩 flags in August 📅 about those tall 🏙️ buildings 🏢 surrounding 🛡️ the courtyard 🏡" officials 👮 said 🗣️ but Turning 🔄 Point 📍 rep 👔 was like nah 🙅 Kirk's 🐺 been here 🗺️ before so we're locked 🔐 in on this spot 🌐 and they caved 🕳️ hard!! Despite massive 🏋️ protective 🛡️ ops ⚙️ considerations 🤔 no line 📏 of sight 👀 assessment 📋 got documented 📜 in planning 🗓️ leaving Kirk's 🐺 neck 🦒 wide open 🌬️ to that fatal 🔫 rooftop 🏠 shot 💥 from the sniper 👀 perch 🪺!!

KIRK'S 🐺 family 👨‍👩‍👧 said the report 📜 reinforced 💪 their worries 😟 about how the whole 🌀 event 🎟️ was managed 🧠 with university 🏛️ police 👮 and Kirk's 🐺 private 🕵️ security 🛡️ team 👥 suffering from terrible 🤢 coordination 🤝!! A proposed 🤝 meeting 🗣️ between the campus 🏫 police 👮 chief 👑 and Turning 🔄 Point 📍 security 🛡️ never even happened ❌ right before the gig 🎤 which reviewers 📋 called a massive 🐘 missed ❌ opportunity 🚪 to ID 🕵️ risks ⚠️ clarify 📝 responsibilities 📋 and add extra 🧩 security 🛡️ layers 🧅!! They reviewed 📖 the whole mess 🌀 and concluded ✅ no university 🏛️ employee 👷 acted in bad 😈 faith 🙏 or showed willful 😤 disregard 🙈 for safety 🛡️ but still the fatal 🔫 shortcomings 🩹 were glaring 👀 like a bad 🍆 decision 🧠!! Kirk's 🐺 fam 👪 lawyer ⚖️ Brett 🧔 Parkinson dropped 💥 a statement 🗣️ saying the buck 💵 stopped 🛑 with UVU 🏫 leadership 👔 and law ⚖️ enforcement 👮 demanding true ✅ accountability 📈 for those fatal ☠️ lapses 🔓 that took 🪦 Charlie 🐺 from us 🌎!! Turning 🔄 Point 📍 USA 🇺🇸 when asked 🙋 just referred 📲 back to Parkinson's statement 🗣️ basically passing 🏀 the buck 💵 while the report 📜 makes tons 🧺 of recommendations 📋 to fix 🔧 security 🛡️ for future 🔮 major 🏟️ campus 🏫 events 🎉!!

UNIVERSITY 🏛️ president 👔 Jon 🧔 Anderson admitted 🗣️ UVU 🏫 must learn 📖 from this review 📋 and follow through 🏃‍♂️ on every single 📍 recommendation 📋 after it came out 📤 Friday 📅 confirming earlier 🕒 reports 📰 that campus 🏫 police 👮 skipped ❌ common 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 practices 🛠️ like flying 🚁 a drone 🛸 to scan 🕵️ rooftops 🏠 or doing bag 👜 checks ✅ and metal 🛡️ detectors 🧲 at the event 🎟️!! Kirk 🐺 had been debating 🗣️ UVU 🏫 students 👨‍🎓 about US 🇺🇸 mass 🔫 shootings 🔫 as part 📍 of his campus 🏫 tour 🚌 when he got shot 🔫 in the neck 🦒 shortly after noon 🕛 while addressing 🗣️ three thousand 3️⃣0️⃣0️⃣0️⃣ people 👥 in that Orem 🏙️ courtyard 🏡 surrounded by tall 🏙️ buildings 🏢!! He was rushed 🏃 to hospital 🏥 but later pronounced ☠️ dead 💀 with his alleged 🤔 killer 🔪 Tyler 🧔 Robinson pleading 🙏 not guilty ⚖️ to aggravated 😡 murder 🪦 while prosecutors 👨‍⚖️ seek the death ☠️ penalty 📜!! Kirk's 🐺 family 👨‍👩‍👧 previously accused 🗣️ the university 🏛️ of serious 😟 security 🛡️ failures ❌ and filed 📄 a wrongful 🚫 death ☠️ notice 📋 which can lead 🛤️ to legal ⚖️ action 🚀 against UVU 🏫 for those fatal 🔫 lapses 🔓!!
